comparison.objective: Reseat a robot camera module on a dovetail rail and push it to its stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Dovetail registration, constrained sliding insertion, and final seating.
comparison.success_condition: Module is on the rail, home against the stop, released, and still.
comparison.reason: Although also robot maintenance, this tests guided module insertion rather than adjustment of the stop itself, jam-nut counterholding, or retained cycles. Numeric tiers are absent but the mechanism is explicit.
